LIVE.definition: Event is actively ongoing or scheduled.

FINAL_CONFIRMED.definition: Authoritative evidence proves the match is completed (COMPLETED/FINAL status or official result string).

PROVISIONAL_COMPLETE.definition: Match ended according to score/rules but within grace window.

SETTLEMENT_ELIGIBLE.definition: Match or market passed grace period and is fully cleared for financial settlement.

STALE.definition: Live feed stopped updating; match completion is NOT proven. Full event settlement blocked.

ABANDONED.definition: Event cancelled or abandoned by officials.
